note: REAL-WORLD PARITY CORPUS. Captured 2026-09-02 from this repository's actual build trees (18 worktrees, ~450 GB of target/) and answered by the LIVE JavaScript that this crate replaces -- scripts/{incremental-prune-plan,target-units,dedupe-plan,worktree-pool-plan}.mjs, imported and called, never hand-written. Generated by freezing the filesystem state first, because other trees compile continuously and two live runs of the two implementations would differ for reasons that are not the port. The generator reproduced each driver's own printed counts exactly (prune 231 of 297, sweep 135 units, cap 0 default) which is what proves the capture gathered what the drivers gather. ROLE CHANGE: this was a parity proof while both implementations existed; now that the .mjs files are deleted it is a REGRESSION BASELINE, and it is the only place these policies are pinned against inputs nobody invented.

dedupe.note: A CROSS-TREE cross-section frozen the same way and answered by the live scripts/dedupe-plan.mjs. Frozen because a LIVE A/B/A of this verb could not settle anything: the two JavaScript runs differed from EACH OTHER by 182 files while 495 files vanished mid-scan under concurrent builds, which is more drift than the gap being measured. Sampled to one name in eight by md5(name), which is GROUP-PRESERVING because a group is exactly one name across trees -- sampling on the FILE would have split groups and silently changed the answer being compared.
